label: effort
definition: One goal that decomposes into several sub-issues and ships as one unit: one parent issue, one effort/<N> branch, one worktree, one PR. Closed by cckit effort close, which closes the parent and every sub-issue.
is_not: A task: a task is one issue with one PR and no decomposition.
A wave: a wave is the set of issues that can run at once; an effort is a goal and may span several waves.
An epic or a milestone: the effort is the unit of work and of the work record, not a label over issues.
avoid: plan (as the name of the effort)
